name: Thistlenettle's Badge
summary: Thistlenettle's Badge is an official insignia of the dwarven Explorers' League, once carried proudly by Foreman Thistlenettle into the depths of the Deadmines. Following a catastrophic cave-in and an invasion of thieves and the restless dead, the token is all that remains to confirm the foreman's tragic fate to his surviving brother in Stormwind.

sections.title: The Explorers' League in the Deadmines
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood locked down Moonbrook and the cavernous tunnels beneath it, dwarven prospectors affiliated with Ironforge's Explorers' League delved into the old gold mines of Westfall. Foreman Thistlenettle and his crew worked deep underground until a sudden tunnel collapse separated the team. While his brother Wilder managed to escape to Stormwind City, the foreman and several laborers remained trapped in the subterranean dark.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Rather than finding an honorable burial or an avenue of escape, Foreman Thistlenettle succumbed to the dark perils festering within the unsealed tunnels, rising as a mindless undead monstrosity among the collapsed shafts outside the main foundry. His Explorers' League Badge remained clutched upon his person, serving as the sole irrefutable proof of his death when recovered and delivered to his grieving brother.

faq.q: Who does this badge belong to?
faq.answer: The badge belonged to Foreman Thistlenettle, a dwarven miner and member of the Explorers' League who was trapped deep underground beneath Westfall during a sudden tunnel collapse.

It is recovered directly from the undead remains of Foreman Thistlenettle, who wanders the monster-infested upper corridors of the Deadmines just outside the primary threshold of the Defias stronghold.
The badge is brought to Wilder Thistlenettle, the foreman's brother, who currently resides in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City awaiting word of his kin's fate.

faq.q: Why were the Thistlenettle brothers in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The brothers were surveying and prospecting the extensive mineral-rich caverns beneath Moonbrook under the auspices of the Explorers' League before hostile thieves and structural collapses ruined their expedition.

angles.text: Foreman Thistlenettle carried the banner and badge of the Explorers' League into Westfall; reclaiming his badge ensures a fallen son of Ironforge is not forgotten to the dark.
Recovering this insignia brings closure to a grieving dwarf dwelling within Stormwind's Dwarven District.
